title: PrepLadder · 65.Abnormalities of Placenta and Umbilical Cord

questions.topic: PrepLadder · 65.Abnormalities of Placenta and Umbilical Cord
questions.stemHtml: After normal vaginal delivery of a healthy fetus, control cord traction was done to help remove the placenta from the uterus. Gross examination of the placenta is similar to the image given below. Which of the following is true regarding the placenta in the image below?

options.label: A
options.text: Fetal surface is rough and covered with amnion.

options.label: B
options.text: Maternal surface is rough and contains cotyledons.

options.label: C
options.text: Maternal surface is rough and covered with amnion

options.label: D
options.text: Fetal surface is smooth and contains cotyledons
